_notice: ALL DATA IN THIS FILE IS FICTIONAL. 'Acme Cloud' does not exist. Numbers were made up for the demo and describe no real company.

metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.definition: Recognized revenue in the month, in USD, excluding taxes and one-time hardware sales.

metrics.label: Churn rate
metrics.definition: Customers lost in the month divided by active customers at the start of the month.

metrics.label: Active customers
metrics.definition: Customers with at least one paid invoice in the last 90 days.

metrics.label: New signups
metrics.definition: Accounts that completed registration and started a paid plan in the month.

metrics.label: NPS
metrics.definition: Share of promoters minus share of detractors in the monthly survey, from -100 to 100.
metrics.source: Sample survey tool (definition not yet reviewed)

glossary.answer: A signup that finished onboarding and used the product on at least 3 different days in its first 14 days.
Monthly recurring revenue: the sum of all active subscriptions, normalized to one month.
Revenue from customers who were active 12 months ago, today, divided by what they paid then. Includes upgrades and churn.
